kind: Original educational concept diagrams requested for the tutorial
credit: Original tutorial illustrations. Editable TikZ source accompanies each SVG.

inclusion: Each .tex is an unconditional tikzpicture fragment. Colors and styles are scoped inside its picture. Include with input and optional resizebox.

items.title: The agent loop
items.description: A goal prompts a model to choose a tool. Observations update the plan and can branch to operator review. The separate authority diagram explains permission before consequential execution.

items.title: The evidence path
items.description: Event logs, historian data, and procedures feed a brief that preserves timestamps and source links for operator review.

items.title: Levels of authority
items.description: Reading, recommending, and preparing a draft are distinct permissions. Execution crosses an explicit human authorization boundary.

items.title: Retrieval and calculation
items.description: A grounded proposal combines documentary evidence with engineering tool results. Neither source replaces the other.

items.title: State, review, and resume
items.description: A checkpoint preserves workflow state. Before resuming, the system checks whether inputs and authority remain current.

items.title: Evaluation before review
items.description: A candidate passes domain checks and evidence checks before operator review. Failed or stale inputs trigger a request for new data.

items.title: The application stack
items.description: The operator application delegates workflow control to an orchestrator. Typed tools mediate access to utility data and engineering simulators.

items.title: Input freshness exercise
items.description: At the 15:05 review, telemetry is 30 minutes old, the study is 25 minutes old, and the alarm is 3 minutes old. Check whether the inputs describe the post-event state. Request fresh data or justification for using earlier data. No fixed age threshold is implied.

items.title: AES audit review workflow
items.description: Simplified teaching reconstruction of the published AES case: documents feed coordinated review agents, which prepare a score and report for human review.
items.disclosure: Original simplified teaching illustration based on the cited case. Not a vendor-provided architecture or measured execution trace.

items.title: TC Energy Piper workflow
items.description: Simplified teaching reconstruction: Textract extracts records, Claude and Strands agents support cross-checks, and engineers review outputs. Bedrock AgentCore hosts agents and tools. AWS Step Functions coordinates processing.
items.disclosure: Original simplified teaching illustration based on the cited case. Not a vendor-provided architecture or measured execution trace.

items.title: Duke Energy study workflow
items.description: Simplified teaching reconstruction: workflow agents prepare a case and coordinate existing engineering tools. An engineer confirms the case before the simulator study and reviews the report.
items.disclosure: Original simplified teaching illustration based on the cited case. Not a vendor-provided architecture or measured execution trace.
